name: progress
description: The native progress element as a thin bar in a hue, filled to its value, or striped and moving when it has none.

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: The hue of the filled part.

attributes.name: data-size
attributes.description: The bar's thickness: half the size's space step.

tokens.name: --yeti-progress-radius
tokens.description: Corner of the bar and of its value.

a11y.notes: Put the class on a progress element and give it a name with aria-label or aria-labelledby. Keep its text content current ("40%"), since older assistive tech reads that. Leave out value for work whose length is unknown; the element is then indeterminate and says so.
